patch_description: The compact-swarm variant improved mean error but worsened the hardest case, suggesting that broader relocation needs stronger anchor preservation. This policy allocates a target squared relocation distance across a small scout group, subtracting bounded credit for existing dispersion. Larger observed losses increase the exploration budget and recruit an additional scout; remaining particles preserve local structure. Memories are reevaluated and velocities retained because the feedback does not establish a benefit from discarding them. This is an untested hypothesis, not a measured improvement.
